title: Terms and Policies
subtitle: The text the web, the app and the landing site show. A published version never changes: to change it, create a new version, save it as a draft and publish it. When published, every account must accept it on its next visit.
newVersionHint: Starts from the text in force; nothing changes for anyone until you publish it.
summaryHint: Shown to people when they are asked to accept this version.
contentHint: Format: a line starting with "## " is a clause title, "### " a sub-clause title, "- " a list item; a blank line separates paragraphs. No HTML.
missingTitle: Each text needs at least one clause title ("## ").
emptyLanguage: No text: Spanish will be shown.
publishConfirm: Publish version {{version}}? It becomes the version in force and every account will have to accept it on its next visit. This cannot be undone.
